blocks.raw: <ExamTip>SPP 202 establishes six distinct phases, but the fee structure references five fee percentages totaling 100% of the contract sum. The Project Definition Phase is foundational work that precedes the five fee-earning phases in regular practice fee calculations.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>The five fee-earning phases under SPP 202 distribute fees as follows: Schematic Design 15%, Design Development 20%, Contract Documents 50%, Bidding Assistance 5%, and Construction Administration 10%. The cumulative fee reaches 15% after schematic design, 35% after design development, 85% after contract documents, 90% after bidding, and 100% upon completion of construction administration. Contract Documents represents the largest single phase payment.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <Warn>Foreign architects must secure a Temporary/Special Permit and a work permit from the Department of Labor and Employment, and must collaborate with a local registered and licensed architect. BPO and KPO firms registered in the Philippines cannot provide architectural services for Philippine projects unless they are PRC-registered architectural firms.</Warn>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>SPP Document 202 defines regular design services under a six-phase framework that organizes the architect's work from project definition through construction administration. The document addresses both individual and group architectural practice while clarifying foreign architect requirements and BPO restrictions for Philippine projects.</ExamTip>
